capital: Chisinau in Romanian (Kishinev in Russian) · pronounced KEE-shee-now (KIH-shi-nyov)
rulers: President Maia SANDU (since 24 December 2020); Prime Minister Alexandru MUNTEANU (since 1 November 2025)
economy: upper middle-income Eastern European economy; sustained growth reversed by COVID-19; significant remittances; Russian energy and regional dependence; agricultural exporter; declining workforce due to emigration and low fertility GDP (PPP): $39.342 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Armed Forces of the Republic of Moldova (Forțele Armate ale Republicii Moldova): National Army (comprised of Land Forces, Air Force) Ministry of Internal Affairs: General Inspectorate of Police (GPI), Border Police Department, Carabinieri Troops Department (2025) Expenditure: 0.6% of GDP (2024 est.)
